steps.description: A table of 4 items by sums 0..6. dp[i][s] will be true exactly when some subset of the first 4 values sums to exactly s.
With no items considered yet, the only reachable sum is 0 — the empty subset. dp[0][0] = true, and dp[0][s] = false for every s > 0, since there is nothing available to add.
dp[1][0]: skipping item 1 (worth 1) is enough, since dp[0][0] was already true. dp[1][0] = true.
dp[1][1]: taking item 1 (worth 1) reaches it: s - 1 = 0, and dp[0][0] was true. dp[1][1] = true.
dp[1][2]: skipping leaves dp[0][2] false, and taking needs dp[0][1], also false. dp[1][2] = false.
dp[1][3]: skipping leaves dp[0][3] false, and taking needs dp[0][2], also false. dp[1][3] = false.
dp[1][4]: skipping leaves dp[0][4] false, and taking needs dp[0][3], also false. dp[1][4] = false.
dp[1][5]: skipping leaves dp[0][5] false, and taking needs dp[0][4], also false. dp[1][5] = false.
dp[1][6]: skipping leaves dp[0][6] false, and taking needs dp[0][5], also false. dp[1][6] = false.
dp[2][0]: skipping item 2 (worth 2) is enough, since dp[1][0] was already true. dp[2][0] = true.
dp[2][1]: skipping item 2 (worth 2) is enough, since dp[1][1] was already true. dp[2][1] = true.
dp[2][2]: taking item 2 (worth 2) reaches it: s - 2 = 0, and dp[1][0] was true. dp[2][2] = true.
dp[2][3]: taking item 2 (worth 2) reaches it: s - 2 = 1, and dp[1][1] was true. dp[2][3] = true.
dp[2][4]: skipping leaves dp[1][4] false, and taking needs dp[1][2], also false. dp[2][4] = false.
dp[2][5]: skipping leaves dp[1][5] false, and taking needs dp[1][3], also false. dp[2][5] = false.
dp[2][6]: skipping leaves dp[1][6] false, and taking needs dp[1][4], also false. dp[2][6] = false.
dp[3][0]: skipping item 3 (worth 3) is enough, since dp[2][0] was already true. dp[3][0] = true.
dp[3][1]: skipping item 3 (worth 3) is enough, since dp[2][1] was already true. dp[3][1] = true.
dp[3][2]: skipping item 3 (worth 3) is enough, since dp[2][2] was already true. dp[3][2] = true.
dp[3][3]: reachable two ways — skip item 3 and dp[2][3] was already true, or take it and dp[2][0] was true. dp[3][3] = true.
dp[3][4]: taking item 3 (worth 3) reaches it: s - 3 = 1, and dp[2][1] was true. dp[3][4] = true.
dp[3][5]: taking item 3 (worth 3) reaches it: s - 3 = 2, and dp[2][2] was true. dp[3][5] = true.
dp[3][6]: taking item 3 (worth 3) reaches it: s - 3 = 3, and dp[2][3] was true. dp[3][6] = true.
dp[4][0]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][0] was already true. dp[4][0] = true.
dp[4][1]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][1] was already true. dp[4][1] = true.
dp[4][2]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][2] was already true. dp[4][2] = true.
dp[4][3]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][3] was already true. dp[4][3] = true.
dp[4][4]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][4] was already true. dp[4][4] = true.
dp[4][5]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][5] was already true. dp[4][5] = true.
dp[4][6]: skipping item 4 (worth 7) is enough, since dp[3][6] was already true. dp[4][6] = true.
dp[4][6] = true: some subset of these 4 values sums to exactly 6.
